teachers.title: Meet your teachers
teachers.subtitle: Experienced Sri Lankan teachers who understand the local context and know exactly where Sinhala and Tamil speakers get stuck.

items.name: Ms. Ruwanthi Fernando
items.specialism: Spoken English for school leavers and working adults
items.line: Conversation-led classes in Colombo and Kandy.
items.longBio: Ruwanthi has taught spoken English for 12 years, to school leavers and working adults in Colombo and Kandy. Her classes are built on conversation. She keeps the teaching short, gets everyone talking, and explains in Sinhala whenever a point needs it.

testimonials.quote: I got a lot of chances to talk in class.
testimonials.name: Sample student

testimonials.quote: She gives each of us individual attention, so we can be ourselves.
testimonials.name: Sample student

items.name: Mr. Kavindu Perera
items.line: Real emails, meetings and phone calls, practised until they feel natural.
items.longBio: Kavindu prepares students for interviews and their first job. He brings real workplace situations into class, such as emails, meetings and phone calls, and students practise them until they feel natural. He explains in Sinhala whenever it helps.

testimonials.quote: We practised real interview questions in class, so I wasn't nervous in my own interview.
testimonials.name: Sample student

testimonials.quote: He went through every email I wrote with me, line by line.
testimonials.name: Sample student

items.name: Ms. Priyatharshini Raj
items.line: Real conversation ahead of grammar drills, with Tamil explanations when needed.
items.longBio: Priyatharshini has taught English in Jaffna and Colombo for 8 years. She puts real conversation ahead of grammar drills and explains in Tamil whenever a student needs it. Her students speak in every class, in pairs and in small groups.

testimonials.quote: I spoke with a partner in every class. That was easier than speaking in front of everyone.
testimonials.name: Sample student

testimonials.quote: When I didn't understand, she explained in Tamil and then let me try again in English.
testimonials.name: Sample student

faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.subtitle: Can't find your answer? Message us on WhatsApp.

items.question: Do I need to know any English to start?
items.answer: No. Your teacher explains in Sinhala or Tamil whenever you need it, so you can start from where you are right now.

items.question: Are the classes online or in person?
items.answer: Both. We run a hybrid model, so classes can be arranged online or in person, based on what you need.

items.question: What is the course fee?
items.answer: Fees are tailored, so we agree them with you directly.
points: Individuals: we recommend a course based on your batch size, language needs and current level, then discuss the fee with you one to one.
Corporates: the fee is part of your tailor-made package, based on the number of teachers, hours and students.

items.question: Is there a certificate at the end?
items.answer: Yes. To earn it, you complete your classes and show how your English has grown.

items.question: What if I'm too nervous to speak in class?
items.answer: That's normal, and it's what we're here for. Your teacher brings you in gently. Mistakes are expected, not judged.

science.title: The science behind the English language
science.subtitle: What you need to improve, how it is measured, and how we build it in class.

skills.title: Four skills
skills.body: English, like any language, has four main skills.

items.name: Writing
items.description: Putting your ideas into written words.

items.name: Speaking
items.description: Saying what you mean out loud.

skills.outcome: Together, they lead to one thing: thinking in English.

cefr.title: How it is measured
cefr.body: The CEFR, the Common European Framework of Reference, is the global scale for language ability. It has six levels, from A1 to C2. IELTS, PTE, TOEFL, the Oxford Test of English and the Cambridge English exams all map to it.

levels.name: Intermediate
levels.description: You manage most situations at work, in study and when travelling.

levels.name: Upper intermediate
levels.description: You speak with ease and follow complex ideas.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.description: You use English flexibly for work and study.

levels.name: Proficiency
levels.description: You understand almost everything and express yourself precisely.

progression.title: How we build it
progression.body: In class, we build each skill in this order.

steps.name: Pronunciation
steps.description: Fine-tuning the way you already speak English.

steps.name: Spelling
steps.description: Fine-tuning the way you already write English.

steps.name: Vocabulary
steps.description: New words you can use every day, chosen for your life and work.

steps.name: Grammar
steps.description: The structures behind the language. This comes last, as the pinnacle of learning.

progression.note: Many people believe grammar is the only thing they have to learn. It is not. You can be confident in English without knowing a single grammar rule.

sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: English Boarding Pass ("EBP", "we", "us") offers live online English classes for individual students and tailor-made courses for companies in Sri Lanka. This notice explains what personal information we collect on this website, why we collect it, and the choices you have.

sections.heading: What we collect
items: Contact details you give us: your name, phone or WhatsApp number and email address.
Enquiry details: for company enquiries, your company name, number of staff, job roles and current English level, if you choose to share them.
Messages you send us, including through WhatsApp or email.
Anonymous usage data: which pages and buttons are used, collected with cookies or similar tools only if you accept. It holds no personal details.

sections.heading: How we use it
items: To reply to your enquiry and help you find the right class or course.
To arrange classes and send you class details.
To improve this website and our teaching.
To meet legal or accounting requirements when payments are introduced.
sections.closing: We only ask for what we need, and we use it only for these purposes.

sections.heading: Who we share it with
paragraphs: We never sell your information. We share it only with the people and services that help us run EBP, such as our teachers (so they can prepare your class), our website hosting and email providers, and payment providers when online payment becomes available. They may only use it to provide their service to us.

sections.heading: WhatsApp
paragraphs: If you contact us on WhatsApp, your messages are also handled by WhatsApp under its own privacy policy.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
paragraphs: We keep your information only as long as we need it for the reasons above, then we delete or anonymise it. You can ask us to delete it sooner at any time.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: In line with Sri Lanka's Personal Data Protection Act, No. 9 of 2022, you can ask to see the information we hold about you, correct it, withdraw your consent, or ask us to delete it. To do any of these, email us at {email} and we will reply as soon as we can.

sections.heading: Keeping it safe
paragraphs: We use reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your information. No online service can promise perfect security, so please avoid sending sensitive details such as passwords or bank card numbers through forms or chat.

sections.heading: Cookies
paragraphs: We do not use tracking or advertising cookies on this website at this time. The site only stores one small cookie that remembers the language you chose, so it opens in the same language next time.

sections.heading: Young people
paragraphs: Our classes are designed for school leavers and adults. If you are under 18, please ask a parent or guardian before sharing your details with us.

sections.heading: Changes to this notice
paragraphs: If we change this notice, we will update the date at the top of this page.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: Questions about your privacy? Email {email} or message us on WhatsApp.

consent.title: Cookie consent
consent.body: We use cookies to improve your experience and measure site usage.

sections.heading: What are cookies
paragraphs: Cookies are small files that a website saves on your device. We also use similar tools that do the same job, such as your browser's local storage.

sections.heading: The cookies we use
items: Essential: we remember the language you choose (a cookie called NEXT_LOCALE, kept until you close your browser) and the choice you make on our cookie banner (kept in your browser's local storage). The site needs these to work as you expect, so they are always on.

Analytics, only if you choose Accept all: an anonymous count of which pages and buttons are used, such as how many people press Get in touch. It never includes your name, email, phone number or test mark.
sections.closing: We do not use advertising cookies, and we do not track you across other websites.

sections.heading: Who provides analytics
paragraphs: Our analytics runs on Vercel Analytics, from our website hosting provider. It does not use cookies to identify you.

sections.heading: Your choices
paragraphs: Choose Essential only and we record nothing about your visit. Choose Accept all and we record the anonymous counts above. You can change your mind at any time with the button at the end of this policy. You can also block or delete cookies in your browser settings, but then the site may forget your language.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: If we change this policy, we will update the date at the top of this page.
